data.summary: Business Analyst with 5+ years of experience supporting banking transformation, operational readiness, stakeholder management, requirements analysis, testing coordination, and change initiatives across global banking environments. Worked on various applications such as Hong Kong Workflow System, Global Workflow Instruction System and MyWorkSpace. My main responsibilities include Requirements Engineering (Gathering, Documenting, Analyzing & Presenting). Worked effectively with business stakeholders to gather requirements from them. Played a crucial role by jotting down requirements and explaining them to the Technical/Project Stakeholders. Have worked on both Waterfall & Agile methodologies. Worked in domains like Banking and Insurance for Hongkong and Malaysia clients. Created various documents like BRD, FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria & RTM from the gathered requirements. Involved and played a crucial role in all the scrum ceremonies like Sprint planning, review and retrospective meetings, also worked well with Product Owner in backlog grooming sessions. Analyzed requirements by conducting Moscow, SMART, GAP, SWOT & Root Cause Analysis. Worked on understanding the Business Process and presenting them using Process flow diagrams. Worked on tools like JIRA, MSOFFICE, draw.io, MS Visio. Handled various Change Requests (CRs) effectively by conducting impact analysis.

responsibilities: Support business readiness and change activities for enterprise application enhancements and production releases.
Coordinate across business stakeholders, Product Owners, developers, testers and support teams to ensure successful project delivery.
Track issues, risks, dependencies and change requests, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder communication.
Support SIT, UAT, defect management and deployment readiness activities.
Prepare governance documentation, status reports, process documentation and stakeholder communications.
Participate in release planning, production deployment support and post-implementation reviews.
Contribute to process improvement and operational efficiency initiatives.

education.institution: Sreyas Institute of engineering and Technology

projects.name: HWS (Hong Kong Workflow System)
projects.description: Manual processing of Fixed Deposit instructions led to delays, errors, and reduced efficiency for branch and operations teams. To overcome this, HWS was developed as a centralized application for staff to create, validate, and manage Fixed Deposits online. The system supported FD creation with deposit amount entry, tenure selection, rate assignment, and debit account verification. Automated validations, real-time status updates, and exception alerts were introduced to reduce errors and improve accuracy. User-friendly screens for new deposits, renewals, and closures enhanced staff productivity. Seamless integration with core banking systems enabled faster and more reliable transaction processing. Standardized workflows ensured consistency across teams and strengthened audit readiness. Overall, the solution accelerated processing, minimized errors, boosted staff efficiency, and delivered a smoother customer experience.

projects.name: GWIS (Global Workflow Instruction System)
projects.description: Manual processing of Fixed Deposit and investment instructions across regions led to delays, data entry errors, and compliance risks. To resolve this, GWIS was implemented as a centralized workflow system to capture, validate, and route customer instructions seamlessly. Standardized input screens were designed to ensure uniform data capture of amount, tenure, rate, and debit account details across geographies. Automated validations reduced manual errors and strengthened compliance with regulatory requirements. Approval workflows with multi-level authorization, validations, and exception handling were documented and streamlined. MIS and dashboard reporting within GWIS were introduced to track instruction status, turnaround time, and compliance. This improved visibility, accountability, and operational efficiency across regions. Overall, the project reduced turnaround time by 40%, improved accuracy, enhanced audit trails, and delivered a better customer experience.

projects.name: MWS (My Work Space)
projects.description: Manual tracking of customer transactions across multiple legacy systems created inefficiencies, delays, and limited visibility for commercial and global banking clients. To address this, MWS was implemented as a replacement web application for the online banking system, providing a unified platform to view and manage customer transactions. The application enabled secure access for operations teams to check balances, payment status, and transaction history in real time. It offered intuitive dashboards and search functionality to quickly retrieve customer data across regions. Automated validations and exception alerts reduced manual errors and improved accuracy. Seamless integration with core banking systems ensured faster, more reliable transaction updates. Standardized workflows improved consistency across teams and enhanced audit readiness. Overall, MWS improved efficiency, strengthened data accuracy, and delivered a better experience for both staff and customers.
